name: US equity stress
summary: VIX just under 20 after the S&P 500's worst day since June on 30 Oct; drawdown 3%
state: The S&P 500 fell 1.8% on 30 Oct, its worst day since June, led by technology and AI-related shares, and was about 2.9% below its 52-week high on 2 Nov. The VIX was 19.5 on 2 Nov, just under the 20 Watch line. The 3 Nov midterms, the 5 Nov Bank of England decision and 6 Nov payrolls fall this week.
for_you: Share prices are moving within normal ranges. Pension and investment values may swing more around this week's elections and central bank decisions.

sources.title: AP — Global shares mixed and US futures advance, while oil prices fall

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
